t: Y Balance Test™
s: March 17, 2025 - The Y Balance Test™ (YBT) is a simple, yet reliable, test used to measure dynamic balance and a person’s risk of injury (1). The test can be performed on both the upper and lower quarters of the body. It was developed to standardise the modified Star Excursion Balance Test (mSEBT), improve its practicality, and make it commercially available (1).
